explanation: All choices have the same expressive GRU and training budget, so optimizer dynamics decide the result. AdamW (C) provides adaptive per-parameter updates with momentum at a practical learning rate and no shrinkage, allowing the GRU to learn the fixed bigram transition efficiently within 512 steps. RMSprop (A) is also adaptive but lacks Adam's momentum behavior and may converge less effectively here despite its larger nominal rate. SGD (B) uses a very small learning rate, no momentum, and weight decay, so it will make substantially slower progress and underfit by the evaluation point.
